KMB_2003_p71__paragraph_2.ocr:
On January 1, 2002, the Corporation adopted SFAS 142, Goodwill and Other Intangible Assets. Under this
standard, goodwill and intangible assets having indefinite lives are no longer amortized but are subject to annual
impairment tests with any resulting impairment loss recognized during the period of impairment. Accordingly,
the Corporation discontinued amortization of goodwill and also determined that it has no identified intangible
assets with indefinite useful lives.

KMB_2003_p71__paragraph_3.ocr:
On January 1, 2003, the Corporation adopted SFAS 143, Accounting for Asset Retirement Obligations.
SFAS 143 addresses the accounting and reporting for the retirement of long-lived assets and related retirement
costs. Adoption of SFAS 143 had no significant effect on the Corporation’s financial statements.
